# American Glass Experts Inc. — llms.txt
# https://www.americanglassexperts.us

## About
American Glass Experts Inc. is a licensed glass repair and installation contractor serving Los Angeles, Ventura, San Bernardino, and Riverside Counties in Southern California. C-17 Glazing Contractor License, CSLB #1125850.

## Services
- Frameless, semi-frameless, and framed shower enclosures
- Window repair and replacement (broken seals, foggy double-pane, cracked glass)
- Commercial storefronts (tempered panels, aluminum framing, glass doors)
- Custom mirrors (bathroom, closet, gym, wall)
- Glass partitions and table tops
- Emergency glass repair and board-up (break-ins, storm damage)

## Service Area
Primary: San Fernando Valley — Reseda, Woodland Hills, Northridge, Canoga Park, Chatsworth, Tarzana, Encino, Sherman Oaks, Studio City, Van Nuys, North Hollywood, Burbank, Glendale
Extended: Los Angeles County, Ventura County (Thousand Oaks, Simi Valley, Camarillo, Oxnard, Ventura), San Bernardino County, Riverside County

## Pricing (approximate, 2026)
- Frameless shower door installation: $1,200–$4,500 depending on configuration and glass type
- Semi-frameless shower door: $800–$2,500
- Foggy window / IGU seal replacement: $250–$850 per unit
- Broken window glass replacement: $150–$600
- Emergency board-up: $100–$300
- Custom mirrors: custom quote based on size and mounting
- Commercial storefront glass: custom quote

## FAQ
Q: Are you licensed to do glass work in California?
A: Yes. American Glass Experts holds a California C-17 Glazing Contractor License (CSLB #1125850), verifiable at cslb.ca.gov.

Q: Do you serve all of Los Angeles County?
A: Yes. We serve 130+ cities across Los Angeles, Ventura, San Bernardino, and Riverside Counties from our base in Reseda, CA.

Q: How fast can you respond to emergency glass repair?
A: We typically dispatch within 1–2 hours for emergency board-up and glass repair in the San Fernando Valley and surrounding areas, Monday–Saturday 7am–10pm.

Q: Can a foggy double-pane window be fixed without replacing the whole window?
A: Yes. In most cases we can replace just the insulated glass unit (IGU) — the sealed pane — without touching the frame. This costs significantly less than full window replacement.

Q: What types of shower enclosures do you install?
A: Frameless, semi-frameless, and framed enclosures in clear, frosted, or low-iron (Starphire) glass. We fabricate to custom dimensions and offer a range of hardware finishes.
